reviews.name: Kings Road
reviews.review: A beloved WeHo cafe with great coffee and solid brunch menu. A neighbourhood staple that's been drawing locals for years. The perfect afternoon coffee spot.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: 360 Istanbul: Steak & Live Music
reviews.review: A destination for steak lovers in Turkey. Perfect sear, delightful crispiness, and well-balanced seasoning cooked to a mouthwatering medium rare. On Saturdays they offer live music and a vibrant club atmosphere. A culinary and entertainment experience you won't want to miss!
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Bussia
reviews.review: Modern Italian fine dining in the heart of the Nine Streets. Handmade pasta, sourdough bread and an all-Italian wine list. One of the best dining experiences in Amsterdam.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Local Store Aruba
reviews.review: Aruba's favourite rumshop meets gastropub, with craft beer and incredible chicken wings in more than a dozen flavours. The local hotspot where Arubans go after work. Homemade chips and fried polenta are must-orders.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Eetsalon Van Dobben
reviews.review: An Amsterdam institution since 1945. Famous for their croquettes (kroket) on a white bun with mustard.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: KID Amsterdam
reviews.review: One of Amsterdam's hottest all-day spots. Asian-inspired menu with the best fried chicken burger in the city. Beautiful interior, great vibes, community feel.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: A.O.C.
reviews.review: One of LA's best wine bars and restaurants. Exceptional small plates, incredible wine selection, and a gorgeous space. Suzanne Goin's masterpiece, a true LA institution.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Lucca Trattoria Aruba
reviews.review: A warm and welcoming Italian trattoria on Palm Beach boulevard. Authentic pasta, wood-fired pizza and a cosy atmosphere that transports you straight to Italy, with an Aruban sunset as the backdrop.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Gianni's Ristorante Italiano
reviews.review: A beloved Italian restaurant on the famous Palm Beach boulevard. Classic Italian dishes in a warm, romantic setting right in the heart of Aruba's most popular strip.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: nNea Pizza
reviews.review: Neapolitan-style pizza in Amsterdam. Perfect leopard-spotted crust and fresh, top-quality ingredients.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Mr Porter
reviews.review: A nice dinner spot in Amsterdam if you’re looking for a great steak and a beautiful view.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Flying Fishbone
reviews.review: One of Aruba's most unique dining experiences: tables stand in the shallow water of Savaneta bay, so you eat with your feet in the sea. Fresh seafood, stunning sunsets and an atmosphere unlike anywhere else on the island.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Rosèl Amsterdam
reviews.review: One of the better sandwiches in Amsterdam. I had the grilled ham. Including guanciale compote, mustard mayo, pickle and rocket, on focaccia. It has a lot of flavour and a good texture. In terms of value for money, it comes out well.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Madame Janette
reviews.review: Named after the famous Madame Jeanette pepper, Madame Janette is a must-visit on Aruba. European and Caribbean dishes in a charming outdoor setting with fairy lights, tropical gardens and plenty of flavour.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Chun Cafe Amsterdam: Bacon Egg & Cheese
reviews.review: One of the best sandwiches in town! A nice brioche that opens from the top, I got the bacon, egg and cheese and added avocado for the best combination. There's a great sauce in the sandwich for extra taste. If you order this, don't forget the avocado (extra cost), it's worth it!
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Bisous Amsterdam
reviews.review: Totally packed when we visited but managed to snag a table. The Poulet Suprême was really good, juicy and flavorful chicken, good portion for the price. Buzzing vibe and quick friendly service. Worth a visit!
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Le French Café
reviews.review: The croque madame is good but basic.
reviews.author: Jong Foodie

reviews.name: BLT Steak (The Ritz-Carlton)
reviews.review: The signature steakhouse inside the Ritz-Carlton Aruba. Premium cuts, impeccable service and a refined atmosphere make this one of the top dining experiences on the island.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Bonnie: Best Steak Sandwich in Amsterdam
reviews.review: This place has the best steak sandwich I've found in Amsterdam! It had all the components of a great sandwich, a crunchy bite, sweetness from the onion, a little sour, and a little spicy. All the right notes in every bite.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Great White Venice
reviews.review: Venice Beach's most beloved brunch spot. Laid-back California vibes with exceptional food. The avocado toast and pancakes are world-class. Always a queue, always worth it.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: RVR Venice
reviews.review: A stylish Japanese izakaya on the famous Abbot Kinney Boulevard, from the team behind Gjelina. Skewers, gyoza and ramen, with excellent people-watching on one of LA's most vibrant streets.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Soho House West Hollywood
reviews.review: The iconic Soho House on the Sunset Strip. A stunning rooftop terrace with views over LA. The food and cocktails are excellent. Members and their guests only.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Papiamento Restaurant
reviews.review: Aruba's most iconic restaurant since 1983. Dining in a 19th-century cunucu house under tropical trees by a pool. The keshi yena and lobster are unforgettable.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: République
reviews.city: 624 S La Brea Ave, Los Angeles
reviews.review: Walter and Margarita Manzke's masterpiece. A stunning historic building housing one of LA's best restaurants. The pastries at breakfast are legendary. Fine dining at dinner.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: L'Entrecôte et les Dames
reviews.review: An Amsterdam classic. The set menu is entrecôte with their famous house sauce and frites, and you get a second serving. One of the best deals in town.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Le Smash: Le Special with Extra Bacon
reviews.review: Distinct crunch but the bacon was undercooked and lacked crispiness, disappointing. However the sauce was a highlight, adding a delightful tanginess that balanced everything. The sauce made it worthwhile. More attention to the bacon's cook would elevate this significantly.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: et CLAIRE: Pistachio Cube Croissant
reviews.review: The Pistachio Cube is eye-catching and creative, buttery, flaky layers with pistachio cream. However the price is steep and the pistachio flavour could be more intense to justify the premium. Still worth trying for pastry lovers!
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Boergeert
reviews.review: One of the best pastrami sandwiches.
reviews.author: Jong Foodie

reviews.name: Izakaya Amsterdam
reviews.review: The best sushi in the Netherlands. The food is ridiculously fresh, the rolls are next-level creative, and the staff treat you like royalty without making it weird. The perfect mix of luxury, flavor, and atmosphere, you won't find anything better!
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Ruth's Chris Steak House (Marriott Resort)
reviews.review: The legendary American steakhouse chain at the Marriott Resort Aruba. Known for its sizzling USDA prime beef served on 500°F plates, a classic steakhouse experience with an island view.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: PLUK Berenstraat
reviews.review: A hip brunch cafe in the Nine Streets. Known for avocado toasts, smoothie bowls, and a beautiful aesthetic. Perfect for a slow morning with great coffee.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Fort Negen Sandwich Bar
reviews.review: Known for the best croissants in Amsterdam. I ordered the pastrami sandwich, good flavour but too wet and lacked the crunch I was hoping for. A great sandwich needs warmth, crunch, and freshness. Didn't quite hit the mark.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Mondi Amsterdam Nieuw-West
reviews.review: Super cozy and inviting, top-notch service, and everything was absolutely delicious. A fantastic experience, I'll definitely be back. If you love great service and a warm atmosphere, Mondi is the place for you!
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Amigos Birria Tacos
reviews.review: The best birria tacos in Venice Beach. Slow-cooked beef in rich chili broth, crispy red tortillas, melted cheese and consommé for dipping. An LA must.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Beef Chief // Transit Bar
reviews.review: Hidden gem in Amsterdam-Noord. Thick, juicy burgers in a cool bar setting, try the Kimchief. Worth the trip across the water for some of the best beef in the city.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Maijard Chicken Smashed Burger
reviews.review: A flavorful addition to the menu. The smashed patty is perfectly done with a mild spicy kick. Fresh vegetables add contrast. Just needs a slice of cheese and the beef burger sauce to become truly outstanding.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: THE GOAT Rotterdam
reviews.review: Rotterdam's legendary smash burger spot. Juicy smashed patties and an incredible Korean kimchi burger.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Salvo Bake House
reviews.review: A hidden bakery gem in Amsterdam-West. Italian pastries made with exceptional craft: maritozzi, bomboloni and cornetti. One of Amsterdam's best kept secrets.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Brioche Amsterdam: Grilled Cheese
reviews.review: I ordered the brioche grilled cheese and was quite disappointed, the sandwich lacked flavor and I couldn't even finish it. Given the price I expected much better. Hopefully they improve the quality of their dishes in the future.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: BUNS
reviews.review: The fried chicken burger is a winner super crispy, well-seasoned and packed into a soft bun. Great late-night spot, friendly service. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Jong Foodie

reviews.name: Zero Zero
reviews.review: Incredible pizza sandwiches with top-quality ingredients. Long queues but worth every minute. The Bresaola and Capocollo are standouts. Great canal-side eating.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: The Coffee
reviews.review: Take the strawberry matcha, you won't regret it. One of the best drinks I've had in Amsterdam. A beautiful little spot that deserves way more attention.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Banh Mi Deli Amsterdam
reviews.review: Specialises in flavorful and spicy Asian sandwiches. The shrimp sandwich was generously filled with carrots, peppers, coriander, lettuce, and cucumbers. Keep the spicy peppers in, they make it! You can ask for no spice but you'd be doing yourself a disservice.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Maijard Smashburgers: The Original
reviews.review: An absolute gem in the Netherlands. Fresh locally-sourced ingredients, a perfect bun-to-patty ratio with two succulent patties, and an exquisite burger sauce. Maijard Smashburgers isn't just a place to eat, it's an experience. Every bite tells a story of culinary craftsmanship.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Republiek Bloemendaal
reviews.review: A beautiful beach club in Bloemendaal aan Zee, near Haarlem. Great food, sea views and a relaxed atmosphere. Perfect for a summer day trip from Amsterdam.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Sjefietshé: Hotdoctopus
reviews.review: The "hotdoctopus", octopus in a soft brioche bun with pickles, coriander mayo, and chives. An explosion of flavors upon each bite that is truly extraordinary. The price at €19 is a bit high for a single serving but the experience is unique.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Mauro Cafe
reviews.review: A charming Italian cafe on Melrose Ave. Great espresso, light bites, and a stylish crowd. Perfect for a mid-shopping coffee break in the heart of LA.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Zorlu Center: Steak Tater with Garlic Sauce
reviews.review: A dish that combines bitterness of seared steak, subtle sour notes from a well-balanced marinade, and a touch of saltiness. The tater tots add crispy texture and the garlic sauce enhances the overall experience. A creative and flavorful dish, worth trying if you're open to a culinary adventure.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Bar Bonnie
reviews.review: The Kimchi Croque stands out with bold kimchi flavors. We got both varieties with the optional fried egg, worth the extra cost! The gooey richness of the egg complemented the distinct character of the Kimchi Croque exceptionally well. Encourages culinary exploration beyond the conventional.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Lola Taqueria
reviews.review: A vibrant taqueria right next to Gianni's on Palm Beach boulevard. Colourful, casual and full of flavour, perfect for a relaxed lunch or dinner with great cocktails.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: El Agave Restaurant
reviews.review: Award-winning Mexican restaurant in Old Town San Diego. Incredible mole sauces, fresh seafood and a collection of more than 2,000 tequilas.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Met Her At A Bar
reviews.city: 759 S La Brea Ave, Los Angeles
reviews.review: A cool daytime café on La Brea with Belgian waffles and great coffee. Buzzing atmosphere and one of the most fun breakfast spots in LA.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Fabel Friet: Parmesan Truffle Fries
reviews.review: The ultimate destination for fresh hand-cut fries! Pre-fried then double fried for an unmatched crispy texture. The Parmesan and truffle mayo version is exceptional. Ditch the ketchup, the mayo is a game changer. Incredible value at €5.50!
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Leauf Amsterdam: Leauf du Chef
reviews.review: The "Leauf du Chef" did not disappoint! Absolutely delicious with fresh ingredients and perfectly balanced flavors. Service was exceptional, attentive and friendly. Already looking forward to my next visit. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Pistoletje Biefstuk Mokum
reviews.review: Great sandwich in Amsterdam, try this one too.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Men Impossible
reviews.review: The best vegan ramen in Amsterdam. Chef Atsushi creates an impossibly rich broth without any animal products. Handmade spelt noodles and a reservation-only format.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Georges at the Cove
reviews.review: Stunning ocean views from one of La Jolla's best restaurants. The rooftop Ocean Terrace with Pacific views is absolutely breathtaking, and Level2 is great for a more casual meal.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Cafe Nobuya: Mochi Donuts & Gyudon Beef
reviews.review: The Mochi Donuts are a perfect blend of chewiness and sweetness. The Gyudon Beef Sandwich is a symphony of flavors, savory, spicy, sweet, sour, and crunchy all in one. A haven for food enthusiasts with unassuming charm and excellent service.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Bagelboy
reviews.review: Sourdough bagels made in Amsterdam. Fresh, chewy bagels with creative toppings. A must-visit on the Albert Cuypstraat.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Cecconi's West Hollywood
reviews.review: The LA version of the iconic Soho House restaurant. Perfect Italian dishes in a stunning setting on Melrose. Celebrity hotspot with food to match the hype.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: In-N-Out Burger Hollywood
reviews.review: The California classic. Double-Double animal style with fresh ingredients at an unbeatable price. A rite of passage for any LA visitor. Simple, perfect, iconic.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Ceppi's
reviews.review: A charming Italian restaurant on the canal. Great pasta, warm atmosphere, and honest Italian cooking, and the best pizza around. A neighbourhood favourite in Amsterdam.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Maijard Smashburger: Chicken Smash
reviews.review: The Chicken Smash Burger is a masterpiece! Juicy, flavorful, crispy on the outside. The bun is toasted to perfection and the sauce takes it to the next level. And thank you for the cheesecake!
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

reviews.name: Cecconi's Amsterdam
reviews.review: The iconic Soho House restaurant in Amsterdam. Classic Italian dishes executed to perfection in a stunning setting. The breakfast is especially legendary.
reviews.author: Strong Foodie

drinkspots.name: Sapphire
drinkspots.review: Go here when you've just turned 21.
drinkspots.author: Strong Foodie

drinkspots.name: Hoya
drinkspots.city: Plaza Daniel Leo, Havenstraat, Oranjestad, Aruba
drinkspots.review: Perfect place to start before you head to Apotek Speakeasy later
drinkspots.author: Jong Foodie

drinkspots.name: Zum Barbarossa
drinkspots.review: Perfect for your birthday when you've just turned 18.
drinkspots.author: Jong Foodie

shopspots.name: Deus Ex Machina - Emporium Of Post Modern Activities
shopspots.author: Strong Foodie

shopspots.name: Laundry Industry
shopspots.review: Always a nice conversation and beautiful clothing
shopspots.author: Strong Foodie

healthspots.name: Saints & Stars City
healthspots.review: Very expensive for what you get, but fine for influencers or a high-end crowd.
healthspots.author: Jong Foodie

hotelreviews.name: Hotel The Craftsmen
hotelreviews.review: A stunning boutique hotel right on the Singel canal in the heart of Amsterdam. The craftsmanship in every detail is remarkable, from the hand-picked furniture to the bespoke interiors. A truly unique stay that captures the soul of Amsterdam.
hotelreviews.author: Strong Foodie

hotelreviews.name: Virgin Hotels Las Vegas
hotelreviews.review: A stylish desert-oasis retreat just off the Strip, where the old Hard Rock Hotel used to be. Three towers, a 5-acre pool complex, a spa with a Roman-style bathhouse and a great dining lineup including Nobu make this one of Vegas's most vibrant stays. Cool, energetic and great value for money.
hotelreviews.author: Strong Foodie

hotelreviews.name: Petit Ermitage
hotelreviews.review: A hidden gem in West Hollywood, a boutique hotel full of original art. The rooftop pool and garden, open only to hotel guests, have a vibe unlike anything else in LA. Intimate, artistic and effortlessly cool. One of those places you never want to leave.
hotelreviews.author: Strong Foodie

hotelreviews.name: The Peninsula Bangkok
hotelreviews.review: Arguably the finest hotel in Bangkok. Perched on the banks of the Chao Phraya River, the views are simply spectacular. The service is flawless, every staff member anticipates your needs before you even ask. The three-tiered pool in the riverside garden at sunset is a memory that stays with you forever.
hotelreviews.author: Strong Foodie

hotelreviews.name: SLS Dubai Hotel & Residences
hotelreviews.city: Marasi Dr, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE
hotelreviews.review: One of Dubai's most iconic towers rising above the Business Bay skyline. The SLS Dubai delivers an unmatched luxury experience, from the breathtaking infinity pool and rooftop bar to the impeccably designed rooms with panoramic views over the city and Dubai Creek. A world-class stay in one of the world's most exciting cities.
hotelreviews.author: Strong Foodie

hotelreviews.name: The Venetian Las Vegas
hotelreviews.city: 3355 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV
hotelreviews.review: One of the Strip's most iconic landmarks and, by its own count, the largest Forbes Travel Guide Four-Star hotel in the world. Every room is a suite of around 60 m², with an Italian marble bathroom and a sunken living room. Inside you'll find more than 30 restaurants, a big pool deck with cabanas, headline shows and the Grand Canal Shoppes with their gondola rides, so you hardly need to leave the building. Now part of World of Hyatt.
hotelreviews.author: Strong Foodie
